content.text: § 18 meets every preferred element, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 contains a full vendor insurance clause that meets our preferred position in every respect: commercial general liability at USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, professional errors and omissions at USD 2,000,000, cyber and privacy liability at USD 5,000,000 (relevant because Vendor processes Customer Data under § 17), workers' compensation as required by law, and certificates of insurance on request under § 18.2. The clause also adds employer's liability cover and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities, both of which favour us. No redline required.
